g.text: Four hooks answer four different questions
Choose by responsibility and supported trigger, not by an assumed method order

rect.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(100%,100%,100%); fill-rule: evenodd;
stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(7%,39%,32%); fill-rule: evenodd;

g.text: Precheck: accept this request?
Check incoming changes before they are applied
to the transactional buffer. Example: reject an
invalid requested transition.

rect.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(100%,100%,100%); fill-rule: evenodd;
stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(7%,39%,32%); fill-rule: evenodd;

g.text: Determination: derive what?
Derive values after relevant triggers. Example:
calculate a default or dependent field. Design
repeated execution to be safe.

rect.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(100%,100%,100%); fill-rule: evenodd;
stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(7%,39%,32%); fill-rule: evenodd;

g.text: Validation: may this be saved?
Check consistency at supported validation
points. Example: a mandatory approval reason
must be present.

rect.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(100%,100%,100%); fill-rule: evenodd;
stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(7%,39%,32%); fill-rule: evenodd;

g.text: Action: do which business operation?
An explicit operation, such as Submit. It may
modify state and return a result under its
declared contract.

rect.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(100%,94%,88%); fill-rule: evenodd;

g.text: Unmanaged RAP determinations and validations have draft-specific support. Implement active-instance
checks in supported handlers/save logic.
